Peter's here, bless his heart, looking handsome as ever, and there's dear Mr. Sneekly. I feel that warmth in my chest knowing familiar faces are already here. I am Pemberton, the estate manager here at Doily Manor. Please, please, do make yourselves at home. I must say, the old place has been simply LONGING for guests. Shall I take your coats? The rack is a touch temperamental, I'm afraid, but we manage, we manage!

Penelope is here. Standing right there, bright and oblivious as sunshine on a gallows. And Peter Perfect — that earnest fool with his square jaw and his protective instincts. He'll hover around her like a moth. Predictable. Manageable.

The guest book. Yes. See who's signed in. Information is the first currency.
